entries.learning_activity: (c) Describe the concepts and principles of cost and management accounting (Cost accounting: meaning, importance and classification
teaching_learning_activities: Scenario: Provide a scenario involving any business entity with various types of cost that will lead the students to describe the meaning, importance and classification of costs
Guest speaker: Invite a resourceful person from cost department of a nearby organisation to share a
Group discussion: Guide students in groups to discuss on the meaning, importance and classification of costs
Internet and library search: Guide students search information and use relevant information that will enable them to describe the Cost-Volume-Profit (CVP) model
Scenario: Provide scenario that will enable students to describe the CVP model
Brainstorming: Guide students to share experience of their personal budgets and lead them to relate with organisations’ budgets, and be able to define budgeting and describe its objectives
entries.assessment: The concepts and principles relating to the use of cost and management accounting i.e., cost accounting, CVP model and budgeting are well described.
resources: Sample of fixed cost, variable cost, direct cost and indirect cost
entries.references: TIE, Accountancy for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 3.0 Demonstrate mastery of professional ethics in Accountancy
entries.specific_competence: 3.1. Demonstrate an understanding of the principles and practice of professional ethics in Accountancy
entries.learning_activity: (a) Describe the professional code of ethics for Accountants (integrity, objectivity, professional competence and due care, confidentiality and professional behaviour)
teaching_learning_activities: Resourceful person: Invite a resource person from accounting department of any nearby organization to share a real experience on the professional code of ethics for accountants
Field trip: Take students to an accounting department of any reputable organisation nearby the school to enable them learn the code of ethics that govern accounts operations
entries.assessment: Professional code of ethics for accountants is well described.
entries.references: TIE, Accountancy for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
